Title: Now available: "Find my partner" for Azure Data Explorer

Body.Content:
“Find my partner” is an extension of the existing Microsoft Partner ecosystem and has the goal to make a faster connection between Azure Data Explorer (ADX) customers and partners. It starts with a diverse set of 20+ companies covering many geographies and solution areas. We are continuously investing by adding more partners to the list.

In order to consume the list of ADX partners navigate to our home page and click on the "Find my partner" button or open our documentation. Please find additional information on our blog.
